about_the_game:
With Ara, always and everywhere! Make your ordinary days extraordinary with the voice of 'Seo Ara,' the heroine of "French Connection."

Go beyond the game's moving story and hear Ara's voice directly on your phone. From a gentle morning call to a sweet goodnight message, 5 special voice tracks for various situations await you. Feel the thrill, as if she's right there by your side.

[TRACK LIST]

  • Morning Call: Start your day off right with Ara's affectionate voice.

  • Words of Encouragement: Get a boost of energy during work or study with Ara's warm words of support.

  • Notification: Have Ara happily announce your incoming messages and alerts.

  • Ringtone: Experience the special excitement of feeling like you're getting a call from Ara herself.

  • Goodnight Message: End your day on a relaxing note with Ara's warm and cozy voice before you go to sleep.

※ This voice pack is available in Korean only.
